entries.summary: A follower now sees what the leader is doing. Its map and floating widget show the leader's route, roaming or walk, playing or paused. These buttons only look: they do not control the leader.
The stop counter for a chain of added points now counts the points you tapped, not every turn of the road. It also grows when you add a point.
Teleport routes now show the stop counter too.
The suggested teleport wait now also shows on the route start sheet and the paste coordinates box, in the app and in the floating widget.
Added Privacy Mode to the GitHub download. It installs a renamed copy of the app, so other apps do not see its name.
New switch, Teleport from other apps. When you turn it on, other apps on your phone, such as Pokemod, can teleport you. It is off by default.
A looping route now starts over at the first stop instead of walking back. To walk back and forth, tick Walk back and forth under Loop.
